subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: After the dashboard substrate and write-back contract are accepted, should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled first-party editable notes/todo/markdown dashboard widget, or leave this as an external/custom widget pattern?
rationale: This is a new user-facing builtin on top of a still-unmerged dashboard product surface, so automation cannot decide the bundled-vs-external product boundary before maintainers settle the dashboard direction.

options.title: Sponsor Bundled Builtin After Write-Back
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back issue defines the storage, bridge, and approval contract.

options.title: Make It An External Widget Example
options.body: Use the write-back capability to document a custom or ClawHub widget pattern instead of adding another bundled dashboard builtin.

options.title: Close If Dashboard Stack Is Rejected
options.body: If maintainers reject the bundled modular dashboard direction, close this child task with the same product decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Bundled Builtin After Write-Back
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back issue defines the storage, bridge, and approval contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history for the bundled Control UI plugin-tab seam and is the best available owner for the bundled product-surface decision.
